newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ parliament to meet on Dec 12 - Prebble.
newsitem.headline: NZ parliament to meet on Dec 12 - Prebble.

text.p: Act New Zealand leader Richard Prebble said on Thursday he had been told by the prime minister's office that parliament would meet on December 12 for the first time since the October 12 general election.
Politicians are pushing to finalise a coalition deal before the resumption of parliament, the deadline for which was December 13.
Nationalist New Zealand First, which holds the balance of power, is negotiating with both the caretaker National Party government and centre-left Labour.
Prebble said MPs would be sworn in and the speaker elected on Thursday next week, while the state opening of parliament would be on Friday.
